nodes.title: 参考视频片段 / Reference Video Segment
参考音频裁剪 / Reference Audio Trim

widgets_values:
Use <Picture 1> as the exclusive identity and appearance reference for the main female idol. Preserve her facial identity, short black twin-braid hairstyle, red beret, cream short-sleeved shirt, red overall dress, red plaid skirt details, white leg warmers, red shoes, apple-themed shoulder bag, youthful proportions, cheerful expression and cute energetic idol appearance.

Use <Video 1> only as the performance-motion and cinematography reference. Follow the original reference video’s singing posture, body rhythm, arm gestures, hand choreography, dance steps, stage walking, turning, interaction with the camera, facial-performance timing, entrance timing, shot composition, camera movement, angle changes and editing rhythm.

Completely replace the original performer in <Video 1> with the girl from <Picture 1>. Do not preserve the original performer’s face, identity, hairstyle, clothing, body appearance or personal visual characteristics.

Do not use or reproduce the original sound from <Video 1>. Ignore the original singer’s voice, lyrics, music, crowd sound and stage audio. Use <Video 1> only for visible movement, stage blocking, performance rhythm and camera direction.

Use <Audio 1> as the exclusive audio reference for the final performance. The girl from <Picture 1> sings according to <Audio 1>. Use the vocal content, melody, singing rhythm, emotional delivery, phrasing, breathing points and musical timing from <Audio 1>. Her mouth movement, facial performance, hand gestures and body rhythm should synchronize naturally with the singing and musical structure of <Audio 1>.

Create a polished underground-idol stage performance video. The girl from <Picture 1> performs confidently on a small but energetic live stage with colorful concert lights, soft pink and red illumination, LED background effects and a lively Japanese idol-show atmosphere. She smiles brightly, sings toward the audience, performs cute and energetic choreography, changes poses naturally and moves across the stage according to <Video 1>.

Preserve the camera language of <Video 1>:
- use the same approximate sequence of full-body shots, medium shots, close-ups and side-angle shots;
- follow its push-ins, pull-backs, tracking movements and angle changes;
- preserve the entrance timing, performance blocking and editing rhythm;
- translate the original performance into the new girl’s stage appearance without copying the original performer.

The girl should remain visually consistent in every shot. Preserve the same face, twin braids, beret, red-and-cream outfit, apple accessories and body proportions throughout the video. Her outfit should respond naturally to dancing, with subtle skirt movement, braid movement and accessory sway.

Audio must be dominated by <Audio 1>. Keep the new singing voice and music clear and synchronized. Add only restrained live-stage ambience, light audience cheering and subtle room reverberation around the supplied audio. Do not allow the original reference-video audio to appear or influence the final sound.

The final result should feel like a professionally filmed cute underground-idol performance PV: lively, youthful, colorful, charming and rhythmically synchronized, while using the movement and camera direction from <Video 1> and the new voice and song from <Audio 1>.

No original performer identity, no original video voice, no original lyrics, no mixed voices, no duplicated singer, no extra main performer, no inconsistent costume, no facial drift, no broken hands, no subtitles, no text overlay, no watermark.
